VDB History Persistence.description: Full local storage persistence for organism history and simulation state.
VDB History Persistence.how: Serialized JSON storage in localStorage with versioned keys and recovery logic.
VDB History Persistence.why: Ensures user progress and evolutionary data are not lost between sessions.

Genetic Dominance System.description: Two-allele inheritance system with expressed physical traits based on dominance weights.
Genetic Dominance System.how: Each trait has two values (d1, d2). The stronger weight determines the expressed value in the simulation.
Genetic Dominance System.why: Simulates Mendelian inheritance patterns for more complex evolutionary outcomes.

Evolutionary Linguistic Engine.description: Phonetic Markov-Chain Generator with Hybrid Heredity and Nobility Systems.
Evolutionary Linguistic Engine.how: Weighted syllable construction, 50/50 surname inheritance, and Roman numeral lineages with nobility overrides.
Evolutionary Linguistic Engine.why: Provides immersive, biologically-grounded naming and lineage tracking for entities.

Compact Glassmorphic UI.description: Density-optimized inspector and registry HUDs with glassmorphic styling and Turtle theme integration.
Compact Glassmorphic UI.how: CSS backdrop-filters, absolute positioning with deconfliction, and a curated HSL color palette.
Compact Glassmorphic UI.why: Maximizes screen real estate while providing a premium, non-intrusive metadata display.

Performance Optimization Layer.description: O(1) indexing for lineage and family counts with debounced persistence.
Performance Optimization Layer.how: Map-based lookups for genealogical queries and throttled React state updates.
Performance Optimization Layer.why: Maintains 60FPS simulation speed even at high entity counts (150+).

Spatial Hash Grid Engine.description: O(N) spatial partitioning for high-speed proximity lookups.
Spatial Hash Grid Engine.how: Grid-based bucketing of entity positions for efficient neighborhood sensing.
Spatial Hash Grid Engine.why: Eliminates O(N^2) bottlenecks in collision and sensing logic.

Procedural WorldGen Engine.description: Noise-based terrain generation with biomes and collidable cliffs.
Procedural WorldGen Engine.how: Perlin/FBM noise sampling for terrain height and biome distribution in SimulationEngine.
Procedural WorldGen Engine.why: Creates more varied and challenging environments compared to flat, wrapped maps.

High-Performance Aesthetic Texturing.description: Multi-layer canvas rendering system with offscreen caching for textures.
High-Performance Aesthetic Texturing.how: Pre-rendering biome textures to secondary canvases and tiling them in the main draw loop.
High-Performance Aesthetic Texturing.why: Achieves high visual fidelity without sacrificing rendering performance.

Chronos Layer Time System.how: Centralized time counter in SimulationEngine that maps seconds to game-hours and seasons.
Chronos Layer Time System.why: Provides a predictable pace for the simulation and environmental cycles.

Metric Unit Standardization.description: Physical traits calibrated to real-world units (m/s, Degrees, Days).
Metric Unit Standardization.how: Scaling factors (UNIT_UTILS) applied to internal simulation values for human-readable display.
Metric Unit Standardization.why: Makes simulation data intuitive and scientifically grounded for the user.

High-Fidelity Metabolism.description: Energy consumption based on (Metabolism * Speed * Size).
High-Fidelity Metabolism.how: Calculates energy drain per tick using trait-expressed values and baseline efficiency.
High-Fidelity Metabolism.why: Balancing mechanic that rewards efficiency and penalizes excessive size/speed.

Resolution-Independent GUI Scaling.description: Fixed-ratio scaling system that counteracts browser/PC zoom.
Resolution-Independent GUI Scaling.how: Neutralization factor (1/devicePixelRatio) and CSS transform-scale wrapper in App.tsx.
Resolution-Independent GUI Scaling.why: Ensures UI proportions and legibility remain constant across all display setups.

Aesthetic Overhaul (Turtle Theme).description: Professional UI transition to EB Garamond and 'Turtle' color palette.
Aesthetic Overhaul (Turtle Theme).how: Global CSS variables, lithographic text classes, and 50% padding reduction.
Aesthetic Overhaul (Turtle Theme).why: Creates a cohesive, premium visual identity for the simulation registry.

Autoscale Logic Toggle.description: On-by-default switch that toggles the resolution-independent scaling (neutralization) logic. Adjusted to target Chrome's standard text size.
Autoscale Logic Toggle.how: Uses devicePixelRatio as the base multiplier while neutralizing zoom to achieve 1.0 CSS scale (Standard Readability) reliably.
Autoscale Logic Toggle.why: Ensures the UI matches user expectations of font size while maintaining fixed-ratio consistency across all resolutions.

Event Log Interaction Fix.description: Corrects the coordinate transform logic for jumping the camera to events.
Event Log Interaction Fix.how: Corrected the offset calculation math to center world coordinates on the screen at a fixed zoom level (1.5x).
Event Log Interaction Fix.why: Ensures that clicking a biosphere log entry pans precisely to the event location rather than empty space.

Extended Time System (60s=1h).description: Deeper simulation time scale where 1 real second equals 1 game minute.
Extended Time System (60s=1h).how: Modified SIM_CONSTANTS and engine update logic to support slowed progression and 3-line format.
Extended Time System (60s=1h).why: Enhances observability and realism by slowing down the life cycle for more granular tracking.

Advanced UI Dashboard.description: Repositioned and interactive dashboards with collapse/expand capabilities.
Advanced UI Dashboard.how: Docked Apex Genomes under Chronos Layer, added sortable filtering, and implemented persistence logic.
Advanced UI Dashboard.why: Optimizes screen real estate and provides intuitive navigation of population data.

Movable Interaction Layer.description: Draggable and deconflicting Fauna inspection panels.
Movable Interaction Layer.how: Implement pointer tracking and snapping logic for inspectors.
Movable Interaction Layer.why: Allows users to customize their workspace and track multiple areas of interest without overlap.

UI Spacing & Log Refinement.description: Density-optimized HUDs with responsive log width and matched padding.
UI Spacing & Log Refinement.how: Unified spacing logic (px-3 py-2) and viewport-based width constraints for notification containers.
UI Spacing & Log Refinement.why: Ensures visual consistency across all UI components while maximizing readability of simulation events.

Sensory Juice Hierarchy.description: Professional sensory feedback system including Proximate Feedback, Kineticism, and Polysensory Redundancy.
Sensory Juice Hierarchy.how: Implemented via CSS cubic-bezier transitions, active-state scaling, and redundant visual indicators (selection rings + alerts).
Sensory Juice Hierarchy.why: Increases user immersion and 'game feel' by providing high-fidelity physical responses to every interaction.

Dynamic Lineage Hub (Inspector v2).description: High-density Fauna inspector with interactive relatives popover and genetic trait expansion.
Dynamic Lineage Hub (Inspector v2).how: Uses hover-states for popover reveals, CSS grid for trait cards, and emoji-mapped neural journals with temporal timestamps.
Dynamic Lineage Hub (Inspector v2).why: Centralizes complex genetic and familial data into a highly readable, compact interface.

Global Fluid Scaling Integration.description: Centralized, resolution-independent UI system using GlobalSpacing.css with fluid rem-relative tokens (clamp-based) and utility classes.
Global Fluid Scaling Integration.how: Consolidated all spacing, layout, and interactive logic into a single CSS file. Replaced hardcoded Tailwind classes and local style blocks across all components (App, Inspector, Registry, Visualizer) with fluid utility classes (e.g., fluid-p-sm, fluid-gap-xs). Tied 1rem to 12px for high-res consistency and implemented an autoscale toggle for viewport-based clamping.
Global Fluid Scaling Integration.why: To eliminate visual technical debt, ensure absolute consistency across all display resolutions, and provide a single source of truth for GUI aesthetics. This architecture enables predictable UI scaling without manual intervention for different screen sizes.

Modular GUI Architecture.description: Deconflicted, synchronized UI layer where logic and presentation are strictly separated via centralized spacing utilities.
Modular GUI Architecture.how: Extracted all local CSS and hardcoded Tailwind spacing into GlobalSpacing.css. Components now consume semantic tokens rather than ad-hoc values. Standardized on fluid-rounded-md for layout and juice-interactive for feedback.
Modular GUI Architecture.why: To increase maintainability and allow for rapid aesthetic re-skinning without touching component logic. Ensures the 'Wow' factor remains consistent as new features are added.

⭐ SDF Procedural Rendering Engine.description: GPU-accelerated WebGL pipeline using Signed Distance Fields (SDF) for organic, high-performance entity rendering.
⭐ SDF Procedural Rendering Engine.how: Refactored SimulationCanvas to a single-pass fullscreen quad shader. Implemented sdCapsule for skeletal bodies, metaball blending via smin, and data-texture uniforms for 1000+ entity state updates. Supports dynamic wobbles, Fresnel highlights, and Distance Field Auras.
⭐ SDF Procedural Rendering Engine.why: Enables 10x population density (1000+ entities) while achieving a 'juicy jelly' aesthetic that is physically impossible with 2D Canvas methods. Moves geometric complexity to the GPU.

Juicy Selection & Camera Follow.description: High-fidelity Fauna interaction system with hover indicators, interactive selection rings, and cinematic camera tracking.
Juicy Selection & Camera Follow.how: Shader-based hover indicators in SDFRenderer triggered by mouse-over. Double-click logic in SimulationCanvas for smooth camera interpolation toward followed targets.
Juicy Selection & Camera Follow.why: Significantly improves the 'game feel' and usability by making it easier to track and inspect moving Faunas.

Selection Juice & Tailwind Removal.description: Clean-room UI implementation using a standalone modular CSS system, removing external dependencies like Tailwind CDN.
Selection Juice & Tailwind Removal.how: Refactored all React components to use GlobalSpacing.css fluid tokens and utility classes. Stripped cdn.tailwindcss.com script and standardized on a internal source-of-truth for aesthetics.
Selection Juice & Tailwind Removal.why: Eliminates production warnings, improves load times, and ensures complete control over the visual style without external bloat.

Cinematic Camera Follow.description: Smooth camera interpolation system for tracking moving entities.
Cinematic Camera Follow.how: Implemented via double-click detection in SimulationCanvas and lerp-based position updates in the rendering loop.
Cinematic Camera Follow.why: Enhances observability and user engagement by allowing seamless tracking of specific Faunas.

Juiced Selection Logic v2.description: High-precision coordinate alignment and animated targeting UI logic.
Juiced Selection Logic v2.how: Solved Y-axis flip between browser and WebGL space in SDF fragment shader. Implemented procedural animated targeting rings, corner brackets, and follow-mode compass needles.
Juiced Selection Logic v2.why: Ensures pixel-perfect selection accuracy while providing professional-grade visual feedback for interactions.

Vision-to-Grid Parity.description: Strict 1-to-1 mapping between genetic vision traits (meters) and visual grid representation.
Vision-to-Grid Parity.how: Calibrated UNIT_UTILS.mToPx and shader texture sampling. Fixed a logical bottleneck in the fragment shader's early-exit culling and expanded the Canvas viewport margin to 400px to prevent clipping of 13m+ vision cones.
Vision-to-Grid Parity.why: Maintains scientific realism and prevents user confusion between data and visuals.

Metric Speed Synchronization.description: Accurate physical movement based on m/s DNA traits.
Metric Speed Synchronization.how: Synchronized internal velocity vectors with PIXELS_PER_METER to ensure [2.8, 3.2] m/s traits result in correct world-space coverage per game-second.
Metric Speed Synchronization.why: Ensures that creature mobility is predictable and matches evolutionary balancing.

High-DPI Coordinate Parity.description: Pixel-perfect synchronization between logical mouse input and physical WebGL rendering across all display densities.
High-DPI Coordinate Parity.how: Implemented window.devicePixelRatio aware viewport logic. Decoupled physical drawing resolution from logical simulation coordinates via u_logicalResolution in the shader. Fixed terrain UV flip (0=Top) to align visual map with physics engine.
High-DPI Coordinate Parity.why: Eliminates selection offsets and visual artifacts on High-Res (Mac/Windows Scaling) displays. Ensures intuitive, lag-free interaction mapping.

Hyper-Performance SDF Optimization.description: High-efficiency Sparse SDF rendering pipeline capable of uncapped entity counts.
Hyper-Performance SDF Optimization.how: Shifted expensive indicator logic (atan, pulses) to O(1) pass. Migrated Flora system to data textures. Implemented **Sparse SDF Field** logic using distance-based branching early-exits in fragment loops. The GPU now skips expensive SD math and extra texture fetches for any entity not immediately influencing the current pixel.
Hyper-Performance SDF Optimization.why: Ensures fluid 60FPS performance even when fully zoomed out with thousands of entities on screen, transforming O(N*Pixels) complexity into a localized sparse calculation.

Dynamic Detail DOF Rendering.description: Automatic Level of Detail (LOD) and Depth of Field (DOF) system.
Dynamic Detail DOF Rendering.how: Implemented 3-stage LOD switching based on `u_zoom`. High zoom uses detailed capsules/eyes; Medium zoom disables eyes; Low zoom (wide overview) switches to simplified circle geometry. Added a visual **Depth of Field** soften effect that increases with distance (zoom-out) to hide LOD transitions and provide a cinematic aesthetic.
Dynamic Detail DOF Rendering.why: Unlocks ultra-high performance by skipping complex geometry when it is too small to see, while maintaining a premium visual style through professional software-simulated lens blur.

Selective Mating Fusion & Physical Bondi.description: Dynamic metaball fusion and physical lock-on phase for reproduction.
Selective Mating Fusion & Physical Bondi.how: Modified the SDF fragment shader to utilize a conditional 'smin' (k=0.01 for roaming, k=14 for mating). Implemented a 120-frame 'mating phase' in the engine where partners are physically attracted to each other and their velocities are averaged to 'stick' together. Added a visual pulsing heart indicator and aura during the phase.
Selective Mating Fusion & Physical Bondi.why: Enhances visual clarity by keeping distinct entities crisp during normal roaming while providing a juicy, tactile feedback for the important biological event of mating.

Modular Data-Driven Architecture.description: Clean separation of technical domains (Core, Evolution, Entities, Rendering, Data).
Modular Data-Driven Architecture.how: Reorganized the flat simulation directory into a structured `src` hierarchy. Introduced `Fauna` base class for shared logic, `Flora.ts` for resource handling, and `LOD` rendering pipelines. Decoupled physics (Core) from visual manifestation (Rendering).
Modular Data-Driven Architecture.why: Enables independent scaling of features, reduces technical debt, and allows for 'pluggable' species and rendering styles without modifying the simulation core.

Infinite Biosphere Architecture.description: Uncapped population and Flora regeneration system.
Infinite Biosphere Architecture.how: Removed all hard constants (MAX_POPULATION, MAX_Flora) and culling algorithms. Reproduction and Flora spawning are now governed purely by environmental rates and energy availability, allowing for natural, unlimited progression of the simulation without artificial 'culling' interference, fully utilizing the optimized rendering backend.

Static Terrain Collision Architecture.how: Replaced real-time noise-based collision checks with a precomputed 512x512 bitmask collision grid in TerrainManager.ts. Physics checks now involve a single array lookup instead of multiple Fractal Brownian Motion (FBM) noise octaves.
Static Terrain Collision Architecture.why: Drastically reduces CPU overhead per Fauna per frame, allowing the simulation to scale to 9500+ entities without CPU main-thread blocking.

Standardized Unit Architecture.description: Comprehensive spatial and temporal standardization (1 Meter = 20 Pixels, 60s Day).
Standardized Unit Architecture.how: Consolidated all world, time, and biological constants into `src/core/Constants.ts`. Implemented meter-centric coordinate transforms and centimeter-base biological scaling. Units are interlinked (M -> CM -> Px) for absolute precision.
Standardized Unit Architecture.why: Ensures the simulation is mathematically grounded and easier to balance. Removes arbitrary scaling confusion.

Persistent Diagnostic Overlay.description: High-fidelity debug HUD for real-time biosphere diagnostics.
Persistent Diagnostic Overlay.how: Implemented `DebugDropdown.tsx` with red-tinted glassmorphic HUD. Utilizes `localStorage` for cross-session toggle persistence. Integrated shader-based vision cones and 1-meter grid overlays for visual inspection.
Persistent Diagnostic Overlay.why: Empowers the user with scientific visibility into the simulation's sensory and spatial state without permanent UI clutter.

Scale Consistency & Metabolic Re-balanci.description: Corrected organism rendering and energy logic for metric units.
Scale Consistency & Metabolic Re-balanci.how: Fixed the CM-to-Pixel conversion in `WebGLRenderer.ts` and normalized `AppearanceMapper` multipliers. Re-balanced `BIOLOGICAL_CONSTANTS` (initial energy, thresholds) by 5x to align with the new 50cm size scale.
Scale Consistency & Metabolic Re-balanci.why: Ensures Faunas are visually correct (relative to the grid) and that the ecosystem remains stable under the new unit system.

Metric Spaced Temporal Synchronization.description: Standardized all distances to meters and time to days/years where 30s = 1 Day.
Metric Spaced Temporal Synchronization.how: Unified Constants.ts to use PIXELS_PER_METER = 20 and SECONDS_PER_DAY = 30. All internal calculations moved to metric base.
Metric Spaced Temporal Synchronization.why: Ensures universal consistency across physics, vision, and growth mechanics.

Juicy Fauna Kinematics.description: Dynamic body movement based on velocity and desynchronized animations.
Juicy Fauna Kinematics.how: Implemented velocity-driven bending and phase-shifted wobble in WebGLRenderer.ts.
Juicy Fauna Kinematics.why: Improves organic 'feel' of creatures by making them reactive to their own movement.

⭐ Metric Temporal Calibrator.description: Universal unit and time synchronization engine linking physics, genetics, and rendering.
⭐ Metric Temporal Calibrator.how: Consolidated all multipliers in Constants.ts; Throttled App update loop to SIM_CONSTANTS.FPS; Normalized u_time in shaders to real-seconds; Standardized memory and age calculations to FRAMES_PER_DAY.
⭐ Metric Temporal Calibrator.why: Eliminates 'super speed' artifacts on high-refresh monitors and ensures human-readable biological data (m, cm, m/s, days) is scientifically accurate across all UI components.

Juicy Organic Flora.description: Procedural botanical rendering with dynamic swaying, tapering arms, and inner-glow juice.
Juicy Organic Flora.how: SDF-based cell subdivision in WebGLRenderer.ts with phase-shifted sin/cos swaying and growth-weighted tapering logic.
Juicy Organic Flora.why: Creates a lush, living environment that responds to time and feels deeply organic.

Hourly Growth Optimization.description: High-performance ecological update loop using hourly ticks.
Hourly Growth Optimization.how: Spreading and density logic throttled to 1/1800th frequency in SimulationEngine.ts while maintaining per-frame visual updates.
Hourly Growth Optimization.why: Maintains simulation complexity and density without taxing the CPU main thread unnecessarily.

Standardized Chronos 30s.description: Predictable temporal mapping where 30 seconds equals one full game day.
Standardized Chronos 30s.how: Unified SECONDS_PER_DAY constant and frame-ratio mapping across engine and UI.
Standardized Chronos 30s.why: Provides a snappier, more engaging progression suitable for rapid evolutionary observation.

Consolidated Species Distribution.description: Clean-room organizational structure for different species within the Entities directory.
Consolidated Species Distribution.how: Migrated Flora/Fauna logic, base classes, and DNA profiles into deeply nested subdirectories (src/entities/Fauna, src/entities/Flora). Sibling scripts handle specific species behavior.
Consolidated Species Distribution.why: Enables truly unlimited species expansion without cluttering the core simulation loop or rendering logic.

Accurate Vision Cones (Metric).description: Mathematically correct sensory detection based on FOV and meter-based distances.
Accurate Vision Cones (Metric).how: Calculates vision dot products (acos) against FOV in Agent think() loops and renders matching indicator-cones in WebGL via unified u_metersToPixels uniforms.
Accurate Vision Cones (Metric).why: Aligns the creature's 'intelligence' with its visual representation, providing a scientific basis for behavior.

High-Contrast Eye Shaders.description: Naturalistic rendering of entity oculars via SDF layering.
High-Contrast Eye Shaders.how: Split eye rendering into three distinct zones (clamped dark pupil, pure white sclera, and exponential catchlight) within the fragment shader.
High-Contrast Eye Shaders.why: Increases entity character and visual clarity, making creatures feel alive rather than like animated capsules.

Universal DNA Consolidation.description: Species-specific genetic profiles governing all physical and reproductive traits.
Universal DNA Consolidation.how: Extracted all hardcoded constants into Species-specific DNAProfile.ts files. Centralized mutation and expression logic to pull from these manifests.
Universal DNA Consolidation.why: Allows for precise balance adjustments for each species independently while maintaining a dry, modular codebase.

Genetic Interlinking (Flora).description: Biological trade-off system where physical traits possess conflicting priorities.
Genetic Interlinking (Flora).how: Modified Flora.ts to calculate a 'Mass' factor based on leaf size, stem thickness, and complexity. This Mass value applies a penalty to growth speed while simultaneously increasing nutrient potential.
Genetic Interlinking (Flora).why: Creates an emergent ecosystem where plants must evolve either as fast-growing weeds or slow-growing, energy-dense trees.

Seasonal Growth Calibration v2.description: Unified growth mapping where 100% ratio = 1 Season to maturity (5% per day).
Seasonal Growth Calibration v2.how: Calculates frameSpeed by mapping seasonal growth traits directly to SIM_CONSTANTS.FRAMES_PER_SEASON.
Seasonal Growth Calibration v2.why: Ensures flora progression is intuitive and synchronized with the environmental calendar.

Flora Inspection System.description: Interactive support for selecting and inspecting botanical organisms via the Entity Inspector.
Flora Inspection System.how: Refactored UI components (App, EntityInspector) to use 'EntityData' unions. Implemented proximity-based flora discovery in SimulationCanvas.
Flora Inspection System.why: Provides complete transparency into the simulation's flora ecosystem and its genetic makeup.

Botanical Interaction Aura.description: Nature-themed visual indicators for hovered and selected Flora.
Botanical Interaction Aura.how: Implemented a pulsing hexagonal SDF aura in the WebGL fragment shader, triggered by unique flora IDs packed in data textures.
Botanical Interaction Aura.why: Creates a visually distinct feedback loop for botany that is clearly differentiated from fauna interaction.

Ecological Balance Knob.description: Centralized scaling factor for species-wide nutrient yields.
Ecological Balance Knob.how: Implemented BASE_NUTRIENT_MIN in DNAProfile as the singular originating multiplier for raw energy expression.
Ecological Balance Knob.why: Allows for rapid, precise calibration of the world's energy supply to ensure fauna population stability.

Humanized Botanical Interface.description: Refined Flora inspection panel using natural, unabbreviated language and detailed tooltips.
Humanized Botanical Interface.how: Replaced technical abbreviations (NRG, kts, x) with 'Energy', 'Segments', and 'Surface Area'. Integrated descriptive Tooltip components for every genetic trait.
Humanized Botanical Interface.why: Ensures the UI is intuitive for non-technical users while providing deep biological context for simulate entities.

Centralized Ecological Logic.description: Foundational biological and environmental constants consolidated into a single manifest.
Centralized Ecological Logic.how: Migrated growth modifiers, nutrient scalars, and mass penalties from local logic files to src/core/Constants.ts.
Centralized Ecological Logic.why: Provides a singular 'Control Room' for balancing the global ecosystem without chasing values through multiple files.

Cognitive Debugging Engine.description: Comprehensive sensory and cognitive debugging system with real-time visual overlays.
Cognitive Debugging Engine.how: Implemented master toggle and granular switches for Vision, Hearing, and Communication in DebugDropdown.tsx. Updated WebGLRenderer.ts to pack sensory ranges into entity textures and render distinct colored rings (Cyan for Hearing, Yellow for Communication) using the fragment shader.
Cognitive Debugging Engine.why: Provides necessary visual feedback for verifying the new complex cognitive behaviors and sensory ranges of Fauna.

Chronos Clock Visualization.description: Radial 24-segment clock in the Chronos Layer depicting day progression.
Chronos Clock Visualization.how: SVG line segments rotated 15 degrees in a 100x100 viewBox, lit based on current hour.
Chronos Clock Visualization.why: Provides intuitive visual feedback for simulation time and day/night cycles.

Established Ecosystem Spawning.description: Environment seeding with mature plants at simulation start.
Established Ecosystem Spawning.how: Modified spawnFlora to accept an initialGrowth parameter, passed randomly (0.4-0.9) during initialization.
Established Ecosystem Spawning.why: Simulates a persistent world that existed before the organisms arrived.

Arrival Steering Logic.description: Adaptive deceleration as entities approach their target positions.
Arrival Steering Logic.how: Modified Brain.ts to scale desired velocity based on distance within a 'slowRadius' (2x size).
Arrival Steering Logic.why: Eliminates rapid 180-degree oscillations when creatures are on top of food.

Memory-to-Object Target Resolution.description: Real-time linking of memory coordinates to live world objects.
Memory-to-Object Target Resolution.how: Brain logic finds visible flora matching the memory location (<20px) and locks the 'eatTarget' to the live object.
Memory-to-Object Target Resolution.why: Ensures reliable pathing-to-eating transition even when target was initially known only by memory.

Broken Memory Pruning.description: Failsafe to clear stale memories if a location is reached but the target is absent.
Broken Memory Pruning.how: Conditional check in Brain.ts: if arrived at memory location but no live object found, return a random wander force to break the loop.
Broken Memory Pruning.why: Prevents creatures from stalling indefinitely at the ruins of a past meal.

World Seed Persistence.description: Standardized map regeneration using a shared terrain seed.
World Seed Persistence.how: Stores a 64-bit random seed in SimulationState and passes it to TerrainManager on init and reload.
World Seed Persistence.why: Ensures map geometry (cliffs, biomes) stays permanent between browser refreshes.

Safe Botanical Spawning.how: Modified spawnFlora to check the TerrainManager collision grid, preventing food from spawning in unreachable cliff areas.
Safe Botanical Spawning.why: Eliminates pathing bottlenecks where creatures get stuck trying to reach food behind impassable barriers.

Stuck Prevention Impulse.description: Dynamic recovery mechanism for stationary entities.
Stuck Prevention Impulse.how: Monitors animal speed; if velocity is < 0.05, injects a random steering impulse in Brain.ts.
Stuck Prevention Impulse.why: Ensures creatures don't get trapped in corners or stagnant noise zones.

Storage Management & Quota Recovery.description: Byte-aware and non-recursive storage persistence system.
Storage Management & Quota Recovery.how: Implements controlled pruning of history to free space for critical simulation state. Replaces recursive save calls with a loop-based recovery to prevent stack overflows.
Storage Management & Quota Recovery.why: Prevents application crashes (Maximum call stack size exceeded) and data loss (QuotaExceededError) when browser storage limits are reached.

Bioluminescent VFX & Modular Rendering.description: Saturation-preserving glow system and modular rendering profiles for organisms.
Bioluminescent VFX & Modular Rendering.how: Refactored fragment shaders to use non-washing additive blending and implemented appearanceType-based logic in the rendering pipeline.
Bioluminescent VFX & Modular Rendering.why: Fixes 'white-washed' visuals and enables future species-specific visual environments and debugging hooks.

Strict Bio-Communication & Neural Stacki.description: Range-limited communication with greeting validation, cooldowns, and memory stacking.
Strict Bio-Communication & Neural Stacki.how: Enforces Vocalization vs Hearing range checks in Brain.ts. Implemented 5s interaction cooldowns and a uniqueness check to prevent redundant data sharing. Memories stack (x#) and auto-pin high-volume entries to the top of the neural log.
Strict Bio-Communication & Neural Stacki.why: Reduces population-wide computational overhead (Database I/O) and ensures social interactions are biologically realistic and efficient.

Refined Neuro-Lexicon & Perception Throt.description: Advanced ideographic memory syntax with multi-entity grouping and frequency-capped perception logging.
Refined Neuro-Lexicon & Perception Throt.how: Implemented a 60-frame perception cooldown in Brain.ts, grouped familiar entities in MemorySystem.ts, and introduced a syntax formatter in SymbolMap.ts. Grouped memories (👥) feature interactive name-list tooltips.
Refined Neuro-Lexicon & Perception Throt.why: Prevents memory log flooding (x144 counts), optimizes neural storage, and provides a more realistic, non-verbal cognitive representation for organisms.
